messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Sprint 14 kickoff. Main goals: (1) billing API refactor (ATLS-42) — sarah-chen taking point, (2) rate limiting (ATLS-38), (3) unblock premium tier once Lumen ships v2. Assigning ATLS-42 to myself since I have the most context on the CQRS design.

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: Sounds good. I'll pick up the billing refactor implementation once you finalize the design. Also I can pair on the CQRS split.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: On it for the v1 cleanup (ATLS-29) and the NPE bug (ATLS-41). Both should be quick wins early sprint.

messages.author: morgan-park
messages.text: I'll start on test coverage (ATLS-44). Currently at 28% on renewal logic — targeting 85% this sprint.

title: #atlas-lumen-sync: Auth v2 dependency — when does it land?

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Hey Lumen team — we have ATLS-55 blocked on /api/auth/tokens/v2 shipping. June 15 is the v1 sunset and we need ~1 week to migrate after your endpoint is stable. What's the ETA?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: We started LMNE-22 this sprint. The scopes schema is the tricky part — PM still needs to sign off on the field names. Optimistic: end of sprint (May 10). Realistic: first week of next sprint (May 18). Will keep you posted.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: May 18 would be really tight for us to migrate and test before June 15. Is there anything we can do to accelerate the PM sign-off?

messages.author: jordan-lee
messages.text: I've been digging into the billing refactor (ATLS-42). I think the CQRS split is more complex than estimated — BillingService has 15+ methods and they're all intertwined. I'm going to need to drive this. Can we have a quick sync?

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Let's sync Thursday. I can walk you through the design. It's 8 story points for a reason — the read/write path separation touches the DB layer too.

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: FYI: Jira still shows sarah-chen as assignee on ATLS-42. Jordan, if you're taking it, we should update the ticket.

title: #atlas-eng: NPE in payment processor — found root cause

messages.author: alex-kumar
messages.text: Found the NPE. `payment.metadata.customerId` is null on Stripe webhook events that don't originate from checkout sessions — apparently card updates don't include it. Adding a null check and a regression test. Should be merged today.

messages.author: sarah-chen
messages.text: Good catch. Let's add it to the hotfix backlog too — there might be other metadata fields we're not null-checking.
